## Description

Final commit of an ingest run.

1. If `generated/dot-gitignore` exists, copies it over `.gitignore` and commits it.
2. Force-adds everything in `generated/` and commits it as "Adding generated files and logs".

When `generated/` does not exist, it does nothing.

## Usage

```bash
./automations/30_cleanup_aux.sh
```

### Environment Variables

- `SkipProcessing` - When `yes`, the script exits immediately.
- `jiraticket` - When set, commit messages start with `<jiraticket> #comment [skip ci]`; otherwise with `[skip ci]`.
